what: Row ids looked at or sent to a model before the test split was drawn, and the sha256 of dataset row ids that were already public in a committed ledger or tracked file. The ledgers, lists and notebooks they were read from are not kept in the repository; goldrails_bench.overlap.prior_use reads this file in their place, so the integrity check of the freeze manifests and the dataset build give the same result without them.

roles.examined: ids on the examined list (less documented clearances) or seen in a smoke, pilot or diagnostic output or notebook
roles.results_ledgers: ids in an earlier result ledger
roles.published_result_ids_sha256: sha256 of each dataset row id that was in a committed result ledger
roles.tracked_row_ids_sha256: sha256 of each dataset row id that was named in a tracked file
